location_exception_reason: Heavy structural fabrications are custom-engineered industrial components specified by technical drawings and performance standards (IS:800, IS:2062), not by geographic origin; location in title adds no buyer decision value and is redundant with seller address already displayed by IndiaMART.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Fabricator, Contractor) in titles are redundant—IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this information independently; removing 'Fabricator' or 'Supplier' from a title leaves the product specification complete and unchanged.
